description: Fix Python language detection, git log parsing, and completion method collision

files_modified.reason: Multiple critical fixes: language detection using input_path instead of metadata_cache; git log parsing using proper delimiter; completion method name collision resolved by adding separate _generate_completions_list method.

issues_addressed: _detect_language incorrectly used metadata_cache instead of input_path for extension detection
Git log parsing split incorrectly on newlines instead of using proper delimiter
_generate_completions method collision - one returns modified content, another should return analysis list
improvements: Fixed language detection to use input_path parameter for accurate file extension checking
Updated git log format to use pipe delimiter (%H|%an|%ad|%s) with proper parsing
Added _generate_completions_list method that returns completion suggestions without modifying content
Enhanced completion suggestions with Python f-string, type hints, and docstring recommendations
Added shell scripting safety suggestions for variable quoting and error handling
rollback_notes: Can revert by restoring original _detect_language, git log parsing, and removing _generate_completions_list method
